text: Analysis rasters were produced by prithvi-eo-2.0-300m-frozen (version v1-clean) from Sentinel-2 Jan-Mar dry-season median composites, years [2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025]. Supervision: Dynamic World-derived supervision. Class scheme: 0 background/bare, 1 vegetation, 2 waterbody, 3 built-up, at 10 m resolution.

Deployed model accuracy on the geographic holdout (agreement with Dynamic World-derived labels): mIoU 0.714; per-class IoU background 0.436, vegetation 0.798, water 0.741, built-up 0.879. These measure agreement with product-derived labels, not ground truth.

Benchmark comparison: SegFormer MiT-B0 (7-band, ImageNet init) scored mIoU 0.672 on the same holdout (background 0.333, vegetation 0.784, water 0.717, built-up 0.853); the deployed Prithvi model scored higher on all four classes.

Spatial coverage: the 198 BBMP wards of Bengaluru. Temporal coverage: annual epochs 2019-2025 (Sentinel-2 era; earlier years are not servable). Electronic City lies largely outside the BBMP boundary and is not covered.
